notes: Stability release: a full app scan found and fixed 23 bugs. Failover chain no longer loops (walks to the next backup), daily limits switch providers before a task starts, HTTP 402 out-of-credits triggers failover, sessions no longer die when your code merely mentions 'rate limit', terminal/transcript memory leaks fixed, key-store failures no longer crash onboarding. Same signing key as v1.0.8 — installs directly over it.
